instruction: A candid action photograph captured from a full shot at eye-level shows a martial arts dojo with yellow walls and a red and blue mat floor. On the left, the woman in the black martial arts uniform with a red belt (R2) lunges forward to the right, extending her right arm in a strike. On the right, the man in the black martial arts uniform with white stripes (R1) stands in a wide stance, facing left, blocking her strike with his crossed arms. The woman's (R2) arm makes contact with the man's (R1) raised forearms. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead indoor lighting, highlighting the warm yellow walls and vibrant floor mats.
elements: R2 lunges forward and extends her right arm in a strike toward R1
R1 blocks R2's strike with raised crossed forearms
R2's striking arm makes contact with R1's raised forearms
R1 stands in a wide blocking stance while facing R2
R1 and R2 are in a martial arts dojo with yellow walls and red and blue mat flooring

questions.q: Is R1 blocking R2's incoming strike with his crossed forearms, rather than R2 blocking a strike from R1?
questions.element: R1 has the defensive blocking duty while R2 attacks

questions.element: R2 has the attacking striking duty toward R1

questions.element: R2's attacking arm contacts R1's defensive forearms
